reason: The README describes a planned DeepSeek Harness credential provider that stores writable secrets in Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, or Linux Secret Service while preserving the existing credentials API; it is not yet installable, so approval is premature.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于操作系统凭据存储的凭据管理适配器，并保留现有凭据 API。
summaries.en: Provides a planned DeepSeek Harness credential adapter that uses operating-system credential stores while preserving the existing credentials API.

capabilities: Planned access to credential references through the existing ctx.credentials API
Planned storage and removal of writable secrets using platform credential stores
Planned reading of inherited environment variables as a read-only credential source
Planned publication of credential update events
